label: Add Tag
description: Adds a tag to the item this workflow is about.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: The name of the tag to add, e.g. "retired".

replaceExisting.label: Replace existing
replaceExisting.description: Also remove any other tag from the same group as the added tag.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Which resource the handler works on: "created" for what the execution created, if anything, or else the event's target (the default); "target" for the event's target even after a creation.
